current.text: He is in a crowded OKC frontcourt with Chet Holmgren, Isaiah Hartenstein, Al Horford and Thomas Sorber.
He is the third center in the rotation, behind Hartenstein and Holmgren.
He gets real minutes only when the centers ahead of him are out, so Hartenstein's role looks secure.

note: Both sites value him at 0 USD and rank him 223 (Yahoo) and 232 (ESPN), well outside the 144 players our league drafts, so do not draft him.
